    int to, cap, flow, cost, next;
} edges[MAX_EDGES];

int head[MAX_NODES], edgeCount;
int dist[MAX_NODES], prevEdge[MAX_NODES];
bool inQueue[MAX_NODES];

void initialize(int totalNodes) {

    edgeCount = 0;

    edges[edgeCount] = {v, capacity, 0, cost, head[u]};
    head[u] = edgeCount++;
    
    edges[edgeCount] = {u, 0, 0, -cost, head[v]};
    head[v] = edgeCount++;

    fill(inQueue, inQueue + nodeCount, false);
    fill(prevEdge, prevEdge + nodeCount, -1);
    
    queue<int> q;
    dist[source] = 0;
    inQueue[source] = true;
    q.push(source);
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        inQueue[u] = false;

                }
            }

        for (int i = prevEdge[sink]; i != -1; i = prevEdge[edges[i ^ 1].to]) {
            bottleneck = min(bottleneck, edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow);
        }
        
        for (int i = prevEdge[sink]; i != -1; i = prevEdge[edges[i ^ 1].to]) {
            edges[i].flow += bottleneck;
            edges[i ^ 1].flow -= bottleneck;
            totalCost += edges[i].cost * bottleneck;
        }
        
        totalFlow += bottleneck;
    }
    
    return {totalFlow, totalCost};
